title: HMD Touch 4G
summary: HMD (the company behind Nokia phones) has announced the HMD Touch 4G, an affordable feature phone with 4G connectivity designed for budget-conscious consumers seeking basic smartphone functionality.
problem_solved: Provides affordable 4G connectivity for emerging markets and users who need basic calling, messaging, and essential apps without smartphone complexity.
why_valuable: Makes modern 4G connectivity accessible to price-sensitive consumers and those transitioning from basic feature phones, while supporting popular apps like WhatsApp.
